note: RFC-0026 development profile (RFC-0018 A1): no security level, FS unproven, PCS conjectural, no zero-knowledge. Prover time is the prove-dev process wall time: Artifact decode, weight commitment, executor capture (witness), plain check and proof; the witness is not timed separately (witness_recompute_ns 0). Stage model_commitment, when present, is Artifact decode plus model commitment timed in a separate test process; it is part of prove_dev_wall. Verifier time is the verify-dev process wall time. CPU only, no GPU; threads is the hardware thread count available to the process. Peak RSS is GNU time maximum resident set size. Controls are the four statement tampers of rejects_tampers_on_a_supplied_proof against this proof, each rejected by the verifier with the header restamped. Not comparable to W1-W8 records; not a cost-model fit input.
